name: 03-versioned-heads
caption: Native MinIO current-key histories. Permanently deleting the current version or removing its delete marker reselects the original data version; copying or reuploading A allocates a different version. A and B denote exact payload bytes; Greek symbols alias native opaque version IDs separately within each row. The 404 is authoritative absence and is retained internally but is not a certifiable endpoint. A pinned-version control and the complete request evidence remain in the source trace; no AWS cloud execution or API-wide positive guarantee is implied.
method: Independent derivation from raw native-server HTTP request/response bytes, status and native version headers. Four cases, three current GETs per case; expected-result flags are not used.
layout: four current-key trajectories, three recorded observations per row
